newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids up in line with MGE.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids up in line with MGE.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were higher on Friday, in line with gains in MGE spring wheat futures, with little movement noted, several cash grain dealers said.
"It's extremely quiet this afternoon," a Minnesota dealer said. "There's just nothing moving."
Bids in most areas were up three cents per bushel, in line with a 2-3/4 cent gain in December MGE wheat futures.
Farmers continued to hold on to new crop supplies in hopes of higher prices. One dealer said that strategy would likely pay off as end-users run out of already depleted supplies.
"They're going to need the grain sooner or later and I think they'll have to pay up to get it," the dealer said, referring to end-users. "We'll be in a domestic market for a while."
USDA on Monday will release its quarterly stocks of grain figures and analysts expected the data to show U.S. wheat stocks at record low levels.
That would likely raise domestic prices and decrease export business as U.S. wheat continues to be overvalued compared to some other countries, analysts said.
